title: Management update Q2 2026
text: Beacon Scheduling Systems (fictional) management update. Priorities: grow net new ARR, improve onboarding, and review pricing governance. Figures in this memo are unaudited.

title: Pricing and discount policy
text: Discounts above 15% require VP Sales approval. Annual renewals carry a 5% uplift per contract. Sales leadership notes approvals are frequently granted retroactively at quarter end, and renewal uplifts are commonly waived to protect bookings.
